title: VOYAGER: A Training Free Approach for Generating Diverse Datasets using LLMs
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework called VOYAGER that uses determinantal point processes and textual gradients to improve the diversity of LLM-generated synthetic datasets. Its evaluation focuses on metrics like Vendi Score and Lexical Distance across tasks such as creative writing, mathematics, and logic. It does not contain any component evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
